title: Cast Household
description: One hand-designed Cast household. All dates are relative to the anchor date so the data never goes stale.

key.description: Stable slug. Matches the file name.

origin.description: Where the household came from, for example legacy-1.14.1 or new.

campusSlot.description: The Cast always lives on the main campus.

duplicateOf.description: The key of the household this is a duplicate record of. Duplicate records never join groups.

reviewNotes.description: Open issues to resolve during Cast review.

adultsGiveSeparately.description: True when the married couple gives separately: each spouse is their own giving unit with their own giving patterns. Other adults living with a married couple (for example an adult child) always give on their own.

campaign.description: The household's part in the Built on the Rock building campaign (docs/pledges.md): pledges and campaign gifts. Weeks count from Commitment Sunday.

sharedMembers.description: People whose primary record lives in another Cast household but who also belong to this one.

registrations.description: Event registrations the household's stories need (docs/registrations.md). Each registers the members it names on one registration of an instance in configuration/registrations.json, and its expect entries are checked on every load.

instance.description: An instance rule key in configuration/registrations.json whose rule has registrants, such as student-camp-girls.

occurrence.description: Which of the rule's instances: next is the first whose registration closes on or after the install day, last the one before it.

registrants.description: Member keys of the people registered, all on one registration. Each must be in the template's grades on the event day.

registrar.description: The member key of the parent or guardian who registered them. Left out, the loader picks one, as it does for everyone.

payment.description: How the registration pays. Left out, the loader picks by the instance's shares.

frequency.description: A payment plan's frequency, which the template must allow.

expect.description: What Rock should show for the registration after a load. Not checked on a day when the instance has opened only that day.

registrar.description: The member key of the registrar.

placements.description: How many placement groups of each placement key (bus, cabin, activity) each registrant is in.

payment.description: paid-in-full: nothing is owed. balance-due: some is owed and there is no plan. plan-on-pace: an active plan has made every payment due before today. plan-complete: the plan made all its payments.

discount.description: The discount code on the registration.

relativeDate.description: A calendar date relative to the anchor. Either yearsAgo, month, and day (the year is the anchor year minus yearsAgo; a result after the anchor moves back one year), or daysAgo alone for recent events that must stay recent.

birth.description: Age on the anchor date plus birthday. The builder picks the birth year that produces this age.

currency.description: Optional payment method. Left out, the profile picks one. A check from someone who does not come on Sundays (a business) arrives by mail.

signer.description: Optional name signed on the check when someone signs for the giver, such as a business owner.

funds.description: Fund name to amount per gift.

expect.description: What Rock should show for this giver after a load, checked by the builder. Use it for the givers a story or a test depends on.

alerts.description: Alert types (keys from configuration/giving-alert-types.json) the giver must have at least one of in the alert history.

person.description: Member key of the pledger or giver. They must have a giving pattern.

pledge.description: The pledge total. Left out, the entries in gifts are campaign gifts with no pledge.

frequency.description: The pledge frequency. Left out, the pledge has none, as Rock allows. A weekly, bi-weekly, monthly, or quarterly pledge is given as a campaign line on the giver's usual gifts of that rhythm.

pledged.description: When the pledge was made: in the quiet phase before Commitment Sunday, on Commitment Sunday, or some weeks after. A late pledge starts the day it was made.

followThrough.description: How the gifts follow the pledge. Paid in full is one gift of the total the week after pledging. Stopped gives on pace until the giver's giving ends.

gifts.description: Extra campaign gifts, given the way the giver usually gives, or as stock.

expect.description: The pledge state every load must show. Left out, it follows followThrough (paid in full is complete), or is gifts-only when there is no pledge.

person.$comment: A person needs a first name. A business record has none, as in Rock: its name is the last name.

bio.description: A short backstory for documentation and test writers. Never written to Rock.

grade.description: School grade on the anchor date (0 = kindergarten).

expect.description: What Rock should show for this person after a load, checked on every load. Use it for the people a story or a test depends on.

earned.description: Types the person has earned at least once.

inProgress.description: Types with an open attempt, which check-in shows as in progress.

notEarned.description: Types the person has not earned.

steps.description: Step type and program keys from configuration/steps.json.

complete.description: Types with at least one Complete step.

inProgress.description: Types with an In Progress step.

programCompletions.description: The keys of exactly the programs the person has a completion for. An empty list means none.

steps.description: Steps a story needs, by step type key in configuration/steps.json: a class (Starting Point Class or Foundations), a student event (Student Camp or Mission Trip), the Follow Jesus decision, or Student Leader. Set exactly one of classesAgo, events, or taken. Group, team, giving, and baptism steps come from the person's other records.

classesAgo.description: For a class: 0 is the class running on the install day (In Progress), 1 the one before it, and so on.

events.description: For an event step, every one the person went to. For a decision, the one event it was made at, which must be one of the person's own events.

season.description: A season key of the event in configuration/steps.json, such as summer or spring.

yearsAgo.description: 0 is the latest one that ended before the install day, 1 the one a year before it, and so on.

taken.description: True when the person took the step and the usual rules date it.

photo.description: Inputs for this person's generated photo. Never written to Rock, and never used for names or anything else.

ethnicity.description: Photo ethnicity, used only to generate a photo that matches the family. Set it on adults. Children inherit a blend of their parents when it is left out; set it on a child only when the blend is wrong (for example, adoption). Prompt wording lives in photos/ethnicities.json.

seed.description: Generation seed, recorded after the photo is made, so it can be regenerated.

isOmitted.description: True when this person deliberately has no photo, for example a duplicate record created from a form, or a deceased child.

attributes.description: Person attribute values by key. Date values use relativeDate objects.

logins.description: The person's Rock Database logins: the first initial of the first name plus the last name, lowercase, letters and digits only (decision 179). Every login uses the password chosen at install.

replacesAdmin.description: True for the one Cast person who loads into the admin person a new Rock creates (Person Id 1) instead of a new person. That person keeps Rock's Id, Guid, admin login, and roles, so signing in as admin signs in as them (decision 177).

connects.description: Requests to serve this staff person connects instead of the team leader (decision 178): active requests at their campus, in these statuses, that have a connector.

minimum.description: The fewest active requests this person connects in every dataset. The Cast's own requests must reach it alone, and every load checks it.

target.description: Person Guid, or group key in cast/groups.

connectionRequests.description: Requests to serve that tell this person's story (decision 75). The loader adds the activity history. A Connected request adds the person to the team as Pending.

opportunity.description: A team key from configuration/serving.json; its opportunity is in configuration/connections.json.

status.description: A request status name from configuration/connections.json.

followUpInDays.description: Days after the anchor a FutureFollowUp request comes back.

connector.description: Whether the team's leader at the person's campus is the connector.

backgroundCheck.description: A background check result recorded a week after the request.
